model_proposal.rationale: Four internal gates moved into verified vacancy hotspots: node 7→[24,23] aligns vertically with inputs (x=20–25, y=20) and eliminates detour in edge [5,7] (9→7 steps); node 10→[22,24] stacks directly above node 5’s new position [22,22], collapsing edge [5,10] to Manhattan-optimal 2 steps; node 5→[22,22] frees congested y=23 row and shortens fanin from x2; node 8→[24,26] shortens [4,8] and [7,8] to exact Manhattan (5 and 6 steps) while avoiding y=28 congestion. All targets lie in sparse zones ([22,22], [24,23], [22,24], [24,26]) with no collisions. Right boundary controlled by node 7 shifts left from x=27→24, enabling width reduction from 8→6 tiles if rerouting succeeds. Internal contraction precedes port coordination, satisfying 'must change internal node' and avoiding prior collision failures via smaller, non-overlapping displacements.
